pieces.doc: Panel revealed by a `ForAccordionTrigger`. The directive does not manage DOM presence — wrap with `@if (item.expanded())` so panels mount and unmount with the expanded state and `animate.enter` / `animate.leave` work natively. If the consumer prefers to keep the panel mounted (for CSS-only transitions or to preserve internal state), the directive reflects `aria-hidden="true"` and `inert` while closed so the panel is removed from the accessibility tree and focus order automatically.
One section of a `ForAccordion`. Owns the unique `value` identifying this item to the root and exposes the per-item context that the trigger and content read.

inputs.name: value
inputs.doc: Unique identifier of this item within the accordion. Required.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.doc: When true, the trigger ignores clicks and reflects `disabled`.

pieces.doc: Header button for a `ForAccordionItem`. Apply on a `<button type="button">` wrapped in a heading element (`<h2>`–`<h6>`) so APG landmark navigation works.
Root of the Accordion primitive. Holds the open value(s) and orchestrates single/multiple expansion, collapse rules, and keyboard navigation between triggers.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.doc: When true, multiple items can be expanded simultaneously.

inputs.name: collapsible
inputs.doc: Single mode only: when true, the open item can be collapsed by clicking its trigger. When false, exactly one item stays open at all times once any has been opened.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.doc: Layout direction of the trigger list. `'vertical'` (default) maps ArrowUp/Down to prev/next; `'horizontal'` maps ArrowLeft/Right (with RTL swap when `dir='rtl'`).

models.name: value
models.doc: Two-way bindable. List of currently expanded item values. In single mode the array has 0 or 1 element. The `model()` change emitter (`(valueChange)`) fires only on internal toggles, never on consumer writes via `[(value)]` — observe transitions without binding back.
